item.createvehiclesurplus.fuel_tank.tool: A _Fluid Tank_ that keeps any _Diesel Engine_ or liquid _Thruster_ touching it topped up with fuel by itself. No pipes or pumps needed.
Stops feeding. Fluid stays inside the tank.
item.createvehiclesurplus.long_fuel_tank: A _Fuel Tank_ lying on its side. Chains end to end along the ground, up to 8 blocks long, for thin airframes.
Stops feeding. Fluid stays inside the tank.
item.createvehiclesurplus.differential.t: Splits rotation four ways like a _Gearbox_, but every output turns the _same way_ as the input. Put it between two wheels on an axle and both drive forward.
createvehiclesurplus.ponder.fuel_tank_fe: Feeding engines with the Fuel Tank
The Fuel Tank is a Fluid Tank that pushes its fuel into any Diesel Engine touching it
No pipes, no pump: it works on any side of the engine, the engine's port does not matter
The engine keeps running for as long as the tank holds fuel
A Redstone signal on any block of the tank stops the feed. The fuel stays inside
Drop the signal and feeding resumes
createvehiclesurplus.ponder.long_fuel_ta: The Long Fuel Tank is the same tank lying on its side: one block thick, chaining end to end
Up to 8 blocks join into one tank, made for thin airframes
Engines and thrusters touching any block of the row are fed like from a Fuel Tank
Craft it from a Fuel Tank alone in the crafting grid, and back again
createvehiclesurplus.ponder.differential: The Differential relays rotation to its other three faces, like a Gearbox
Every output turns the same way as the input, sign included
A Gearbox mirrors the corners and reverses the straight-through output
Two wheels on one axle would fight each other
Put a Differential between them and both wheels drive forward together
It sits flat by default. Sneak-place it against a wall for the vertical orientation, or turn it with a Wrench
item.createvehiclesurplus.transmission.t: An inline _gearbox_ for vehicles: _Reverse_, _Neutral_ and four forward gears from _1/4_ to _1:1_. Shift it by _frequency_: every long face has built-in _Redstone Link_ slots.
A _pulse_ shifts one gear up or down.
Signal _strength_ picks the gear directly and overrides the pulses.
Drops to _Neutral_; holding it keeps the output disconnected.
createvehiclesurplus.gui.goggles.transmi: Gear set by the analog face
createvehiclesurplus.ponder.transmission: The Transmission sits inline on a shaft and changes the speed passed through it
It starts in Neutral: the output is disconnected
Each long face takes a frequency like a Redstone Link: right-click its two slots with items
A pulse on the Up face shifts one gear up
The Down face works the same way. Every gear is a reduction: 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 and 1:1, plus Reverse
The Analog face picks a gear from signal strength and overrides the pulses
Holding the Neutral face locks the output in Neutral
Lower gears turn the output slower and put less load on the engine
With CC: Tweaked installed, a computer can drive it as a 'transmission' peripheral
Use a Wrench on a shaft end to turn the faces around the shaft
item.createvehiclesurplus.gimbal_control: Keeps a _Create Aeronautics_ vehicle from _falling over_ sideways, and still lets it _lean_ into turns. Place it _inline_ on the driveshaft, shaft along the vehicle's forward axis.
